name: Jinnai Rikako
source:
A second year student at Hanyuu Academy who loves to run and is a dedicated member of the track and field club.

After spotting her doing morning training, [url=/c78405]Ryoutarou[/url] finds himself sitting next to her during their joint English class by coincidence, and the two end up becoming fast friends. Rikako is so shy when it comes to talking to other people, especially guys, that she comes off as cold. Although she wants to make lots of friends, she’s afraid of giving people the wrong impression.

“I’m, uhh, just not used to talking to guys... I don’t know how to respond...”

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1490&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
